To avoid
Aug 2023 • Family
A place to absolutely avoid
Here they take tourists for idiots who are not able to tell the difference between mother fruit and surimi
We ordered rolls with mother's fruit, and they brought us something filled with surimi. The waitress continued to insist that it was shrimp. The second course was very small fish, garnished with sand apparently because I felt it on my teeth. I think their wagyu beef is the same fake as other dishes
It remains incomprehensible why this restaurant, which positions itself as a luxury restaurant, behaves like a low-end cheap fast food restaurant.
Anyway, we were asked to pay the full price, despite the dishes barely touched, we only had drinks
What a shame to spoil our last evening at ho chi min.

Abominable
Jul 2014 • Solo
I cannot truthfully say that the food at this restaurant was bad because when it was put in front of me I refused to either eat it or pay for it. I ordered seafood fried rice and when it arrived (after a considerable time) there was a pile of rice and nothing else, definitely no seafood, and in Vietnamese terms they were charging top dollar. When I rejected it the owner (or manager) and the waiter then both dug around it and turned up a minuscule speck of calamari and demanded this was proof I should pay for it. They also demanded I pay for another course which had failed to materialise and when I refused the waiter became threatening. I paid for the beer I had drunk and one I had not drunk and the waiter was threatening and insulting. They assume all foreigners are ignorant of their language but then this is a tourist clip joint in a district full of them. Sadly this is the sort of place that gives Saigon a bad name when sadly there are good restaurants which suffer because of this.
